decisions.reason: As a close extension to the shop-related offer, this template is likely to stay while management tests demand, though its limited strategic importance and only light website prominence make it somewhat droppable if results miss aspirations.

A responsive website template fits the firm's existing customer base and service logic, so with industry growth and some organisational slack management would usually continue it unless early uptake is clearly weak.
Premium customer support is tightly aligned with the firm's core hosting and service strengths, making it a natural product to retain even under boundedly rational evaluation.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical capabilities and platform strategy, and its dedicated page suggests enough commitment to keep refining rather than quickly withdrawing it.

Because the data-processing-contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's main hosting and support business, management would be more likely to redeploy resources away from it if its early results fall short of aspiration levels.
